  value: string
end
impl ToString for Label
  function to_string(self): string
    return self.value
  end
end
function size(value: ToString): int
  return value:to_string():len()
end

local dynamic: unknown = label
if dynamic is ToString then
  println(size(label))
else
  println(0)
end

function identity<Element>(value: Element): Element

struct Box<Item>
  value: Item
end
impl<Item> Box<Item>
  function get(self): Item
    return self.value
  end
  function replace<Next>(self, value: Next): Next
    return value
  end

name: regression/generic_trait_bound_and_value
source:
trait Scaled
  function scale(self, value: int): int
end
struct Multiplier
  factor: int
end
impl Scaled for Multiplier
  function scale(self, value: int): int
    return self.factor * value
  end
end
function apply<Item: Scaled>(item: Item, value: int): int
  return item:scale(value)
end
function apply_dynamic(item: Scaled, value: int): int
  return item:scale(value)
end
local multiplier = Multiplier { factor = 3 }
println(apply(multiplier, 7) + apply_dynamic(multiplier, 5))
